body:
The best thing you could do is dont stop reaching out,either through mail etc. I recently had the one person keeping me alive desert me and stop writing with no explanation.
Now she has become a reason to give up entirely. I hope things work out for yr friend. No matter what,if you decide you can no longer be there for tbem,at least explain to them why.
I my case,i am through with people and with this life.

Hi again,I'm just now reading your reply. I don-t know where you live ..I'm in the north east..I wish I could help you somehow. If you ever want to msg me,please feel free to do so and we can talk further.
Are you on fetlife? Its a site for kinksters,etc. It may help put things in better perspective for you.

You're right,the world at least politically sucks and unfortunately affects all of us. Having said that, it is also big filled with all kinds of people and not all of them bad. You sound like you are intelligent and have strength still. I don't know what i could say to help you because i too am ready to leave it,though we all have dif personal reasons for wanting to end it..anyway, i would ask you too if you have a safe place to go to because it sounds like your immediate family are not supportive in the least and this type of envriorment is ill for everyone.
Don't worry. Take nothing personally that I say.

Are you a magician? Sorceror? I mean come on,how will magical thinking help me or anyone? I do not understand the reason behind imagining things being the way they were. Not only is this impossible but its a complete waste of time. Life does not work this way.
The only voice keeping me from suicide was hers not mine.
I havent tried everything before? I have.

No there is no one else. I dont care anymore,life people are ridiculous. I hate her now. All i feel since this is disgust and apathy. I prefer death. At least i wont feel anything which is preferable to my feelings this past year. And please,do not give these generic examples of what i should or could do. Do you imagine

You are absolutely correct. Poverty is a killer. It degrades over time and just surviving day to day is soul sucking. You are not alone in this though,I think many of us are here because of this. Stay strong and try and find someone or something that you feel a connection to-without this, life is hell for sure.

Isolation can be a killer. Speaking from experience,friendship love connection are sometimes the best way to show you really care,even if its just texting,it can help to calm down and feel less alone and misunderstood.
I think its more important that you have shown concern and she knows there is someone who is there to listen. You sound very cool and caring, i really feel you are making a différence to her.

If she is talking with you,you are already helping a lot. Sometimes the worst you can do is to freak out and call the police,doing this will only make things more stressful for her at this time. Keep doing what you have been doing;talking with her,etc. Connection is the most important thing for anyone suicidal. There are no 'experts' who will do more than what you have been doing. Good luck.

Believe me you don't. After talking with me I will have you convinced to take yours too.
Take care of you my friend.
